title: Bentgo® Kids Chill Lunch Box - Bento-Style Lunch Solution with 4 Compartments and Removable Ice Pack for Meals and Snacks On-the-Go - Leak-Proof, Dishwasher Safe, Patented Design (Green/Navy)
features: Keeps Lunches Cool: No need to buy extra ice packs! Our lightweight and reusable bento lunch box for kids features a patented design with a built-in, removable ice pack to keep food cool for hours. Just pop it in the freezer the night before and place it under the tray for fresh, convenient lunches on the go.

#1 Lunch Box Brand*: From America’s favorite award-winning brand, this durable lunch box is designed to make mealtime fun and stress-free. Bentgo Chill Kids is crafted from food-safe materials that are PFAS- and BPA-free, offering peace of mind for parents of toddlers and kids ages 3–7. The 4-compartment tray holds 3 ⅓ cups, making it easy to separate and chill a variety of fresh foods like fruits, veggies, yogurt, dips, and more.

Leak-Proof Technology: Our airtight, leakproof design keeps meals and snacks fresh and mess-free. One easy-to-use latch makes it simple for toddlers and young kids to open and close on their own. A rubberized, durable outer shell protects against drops, making it great for school, daycare, or camp.

Easy to Clean, Heat & Pack: This reusable lunch container features a removable tray that’s safe for the microwave and top-rack dishwasher. For best results, hand wash the outer box and built-in ice pack to keep everything in top condition.

Purchase with a Purpose: Bentgo proudly supports Feed the Children, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit helping families in need. Since 2017, Bentgo has donated nearly $300,000 to help fight hunger and bring hope to communities nationwide.
